mapper.select: select i.item_type as itemType, ifnull(i.course_name, '-') as courseName, t.class_name as className, i.education_level as educationLevel, i.major_category as majorCategory, coalesce(th.J1, pr.J2, itr.T, cd.J4, ci.W) as baseValue, coalesce(cd.R4, ts.R5, ci.R6, t.student_count) as studentCount, t.repeat_order as repeatOrder, coalesce(th.C1, pr.C2, itr.K) as repeatCoef, th.K1 as k1, coalesce(th.Q1, pr.Q1, itr.Q1) as q1, coalesce(th.Q2, pr.Q2, itr.Q2) as q2, coalesce(th.Q3, pr.Q3, itr.Q3) as q3, th.N as n, coalesce(itr.D, ts.K5, pr.K) as otherCoef, i.calculated_workload as calculatedWorkload, case i.source_type when 'IMPORT' then '导入' when 'MANUAL' then '手工' when 'SELF' then '教师申报' else i.source_type end as sourceType, case i.status when 0 then '草稿' when 1 then '已核对' when 2 then '有异议' when 3 then '已驳回' else cast(i.status as char) end as status, i.is_over_limit as overLimit, mg.role_type as roleType, mg.proration_basis as prorationBasis from biz_workload_item i left join biz_teaching_task t on t.id = i.task_id left join biz_wl_theory th on th.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G1' left join biz_wl_practice pr on pr.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G2' left join biz_wl_internship_training itr on itr.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G3' left join biz_wl_course_design cd on cd.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G4' left join biz_wl_thesis ts on ts.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G5' left join biz_wl_concentrated_internship ci on ci.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G6' left join biz_wl_management mg on mg.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G11' where i.user_id = #{userId} and i.semester = #{semester} order by i.item_type, i.id

select max(coalesce(t.course_name, i.course_name)) as courseName, max(i.education_level) as educationLevel, sum(th.J1) as j1, max(th.C1) as c1, max(th.K1) as k1, max(th.Q1) as q1, max(th.Q2) as q2, max(th.Q3) as q3, max(th.N) as n, sum(case when i.item_type = 'G1' then i.calculated_workload end) as g1, sum(pr.J2) as j2, max(pr.K) as practiceK, max(pr.C2) as c2, sum(case when i.item_type = 'G2' then i.calculated_workload end) as g2, sum(itr.T) as t, max(itr.D) as d, max(itr.K) as internK, sum(case when i.item_type = 'G3' then i.calculated_workload end) as g3, sum(cd.J4) as j4, sum(cd.R4) as r4, sum(case when i.item_type = 'G4' then i.calculated_workload end) as g4, sum(case when i.item_type = 'G5' and ifnull(ts.discipline_category, 'LIBERAL_ARTS') = 'LIBERAL_ARTS' then i.calculated_workload end) as g5Liberal, sum(case when i.item_type = 'G5' and ts.discipline_category = 'SCITECH' then i.calculated_workload end) as g5Scitech, sum(ci.W) as w, sum(ci.R6) as r6, sum(case when i.item_type = 'G6' then i.calculated_workload end) as g6 from biz_workload_item i left join biz_teaching_task t on t.id = i.task_id left join biz_wl_theory th on th.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G1' left join biz_wl_practice pr on pr.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G2' left join biz_wl_internship_training itr on itr.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G3' left join biz_wl_course_design cd on cd.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G4' left join biz_wl_thesis ts on ts.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G5' left join biz_wl_concentrated_internship ci on ci.item_id = i.id and i.item_type = 'G6' where i.user_id = #{userId} and i.semester = #{semester} and i.item_type in ('G1', 'G2', 'G3', 'G4', 'G5', 'G6') and (i.status is null or i.status != 3) group by ifnull(i.task_id, -i.id) order by min(i.id)

select d.dept_name as collegeName, u.nick_name as teacherName, s.academic_year as academicYear, s.G7 as g7, s.G8 as g8, s.G9 as g9, s.g8_remark as g8Remark, s.G10 as g10, s.G11 as g11, s.g11_remark as g11Remark, s.total_workload as totalWorkload, s.rated_workload as ratedWorkload, s.excess_workload as excessWorkload, s.teacher_sign as teacherSign from biz_workload_summary s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.semester = #{semester} limit 1
